semiconductor_relevance: High — Suzhou Puristone specializes in semiconductor equipment for wafer fabrication and packaging, making it a key player in the industry.
summary: Suzhou Puristone Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, and manufacturing of semiconductor inspection and measurement equipment. Their solutions are integral to semiconductor wafer fabrication and IC packaging processes, providing high-precision equipment for defect detection and film thickness measurement.
capabilities: Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) defect detection equipment
Microscopes including Atomic Force Microscopes (AFM) and Optical Microscopes

regional_presence.China: The company is positioned as one of China's first fully localized developers of wafer inspection systems, serving both domestic and international clients.
